newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand says no plan to issue new baht bonds. [CORRECTED 05:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Thailand says no plan to issue new baht bonds. [CORRECTED 05:00 GMT]

text.p: Thailand has no plans to issue any new government baht bonds (corrects to make clear that the finance ministry official was talking only about plans for new government bonds and did not mention state enterprise bonds) in the domestic market anytime soon, a senior finance ministry official said on Monday.

"I don't see the likelihood of the government issuing (baht) bonds just yet. The government would rather choose not to shoulder heavy interest payments," the ministry's secretary general Chatumongkol Sonakul told reporters.

The official made the comments in response to questions on whether the government planned to issue more domestic baht bonds to help develop a benchmark for yields and interest rates in the fledgling local debt market.
Chatumongkol earlier spoke at an Asian bonds conference.
